findings.description: Latent E-phase gap: stage_a.evaluate_stage_a's survivor gate does not consume falsification_eval.coverage_complete / missing_killers. If a future E harness OMITS a declared/insufficient designated-killer scope from killer_metrics (instead of propagating it via execute.control_verdict_row / battery.control_verdict_rows), R2 becomes vacuously non-killing for that killer while survivor could still fire - contrary to the Q-11 law (a control that cannot move the signal is INVALID NULL, never a pass). No E run exists yet and the committed wiring + ZR1 handoff instruction point the right way, so this changes nothing today; the E-phase dispatch/gate MUST require coverage_complete == true (all three killers present with executed-or-declared rows propagated) before any survivor is recognized.

zr2_run.py::_book_one hardcodes the declared-row reason prose 'every booked trade was excluded by the split-boundary law (N excluded)' for ANY empty booked population, regardless of the actual cause. On this re-pass all 6 declared rows are genuinely split-boundary exclusions (excluded_trades=1, mechanism verified against committed boundary facts), so the committed record is accurate; but a future empty population from a different cause (e.g. an all-flat series) would carry a factually false reason string next to its truthful '(0 excluded)' count. Owner-lane repair suggestion: derive the reason from the actual exclusion evidence rather than hardcoding the split-boundary attribution.

Cell totals counter split_boundary_excluded_trades_all_roles accumulates PASS rows only; declared-row exclusions are disclosed in the separate counter excluded_trades_disclosed_on_declared_rows (2 per cell in ZR2) and on each declared row. No silent drop (disclosure is complete when both counters are summed), and the ZR2-vs-Z totals parity is coherent under exactly this scope rule (crashed scopes in Z contributed nothing to the counter either; ARM2's 1 is a real exclusion on a PASS row). Note for E consumers: total exclusions per cell = PASS-row counter + declared-row disclosure counter.
